statement: Sixteen published binary linear lower-bound constructions verified by two exhaustive implementations; no novel record or target optimality proof claimed. Transformation and upper-bound closure precede final selection.
status: Local pilot; awaiting maintainer and independent reviewer
scope: Final targets n=41..62, k=10..12 in data/records.csv. Bounds are source-scoped, not a claim of exhaustive literature coverage.

assumptions.statement: Reported table upper bounds and published classification theorems have not been independently replayed.
Recent large-dimension constructions are conservative novelty exclusions, not locally verified witnesses.

prerequisites: Python 3.10 or later; standard library only
